goal: get_network timestamps use Unix ms (wallTime) not Chrome monotonic uptime
assertions: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('extension/background.js','utf8'); if(!s.includes('wallTime')) { console.error('wallTime not used'); process.exit(1); }"

goal: CLI exits 1 on logical failures (found:false, ok:false, ready:false)
assertions: TINY_BROWSER_PORT=17331 node bin/server.mjs &>/tmp/tb-guard.log & sleep 1 && node -e "const h=require('http'); h.request({hostname:'127.0.0.1',port:17331,path:'/find_element',method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify({selector:'#never-exists'}))}},res=>{let d='';res.on('data',c=>d+=c);res.on('end',()=>{const b=JSON.parse(d);process.exit(b.found===false?0:1)})}).end(JSON.stringify({selector:'#never-exists'}))" ; kill %1 2>/dev/null

goal: type replace:true param accepted by cmdType
assertions: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('extension/background.js','utf8'); if(!s.includes('replace')) { console.error('replace param missing'); process.exit(1); }"

goal: scroll accepts x,y params to target a specific scrollable container
assertions: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('extension/background.js','utf8'); if(!s.includes('probeX') && !s.includes('scrollAncestor')) { console.error('scroll x/y targeting missing'); process.exit(1); }"
